analogy.rationale: Ribonucleotide reductase inhibitors block de novo deoxyribonucleotide synthesis, causing dNTP depletion, replication fork stalling, and DNA damage; other inhibitors of DNA synthesis, DNA polymerase, and nucleotide biosynthesis (DHFR, thymidylate synthase) converge on the same replication-stress program.
